_description: RQ2 controlled SNLI MR-information experiment, v4: ordered provenance-explicit Operation + constraint-form Relation

factors.L: source-label anchoring (diagnostic only, never part of the core 2x2x2)

_design.operation_model: ordered transformation trace T1 -> ... -> Tk from component_mrs
_design.relation_model: constraint on the (source label -> follow-up label) mapping
_design._note: P/O/R/L metadata is emitted by scripts/mr_instruction_design.py into conversion_report.json and experiment_meta.json; never re-derived from the mode name.

_converted_dir_note: v4 output is versioned separately; the frozen v2/v3 conversions under RQ2/data/converted/ and RQ2/data/converted_v3/ are never overwritten.
_control_coverage_note: pair_wrong_operation_relation_matched never cross-matches relation kind; enable only after reviewing its feasibility audit.
_cohort_note: v4 uses a DIFFERENT cohort file than v3, chosen because it is the only artifact that stores ordered component_mrs provenance for composite rows (data/nli/mettrain/snli_lr0.0037_gemma-3-4b-it-qat-v3_3/augmented_data_all_label_mrs_v3_3_full.json, 5340 rows, 2033 sources, 486 composites with 100% provenance coverage). The v3 cohort (snli_lr0.0037_gemma-3-4b-it-qat/augmented_data.json) has NO composite provenance, so v3 and v4 do NOT share metamorphic examples and their results are not directly comparable example-for-example. Source rows are identical across the two cohorts.
_output_root_note: v4 writes to its own root; v3 artifacts under RQ2/output/gemma3_4b_nli_grounded_v3/ stay untouched.
_cohort_dir_note: v4 samples into its own cohort directory so the frozen v3 cohort files under RQ2/data/cohorts/ are never overwritten.
